# V-Tune

> A precision strobe tuner for handpans and other multi-modal instruments.
> A handpan note sounds its fundamental, its octave and its 12th at the same
> time; V-Tune reads all three as independent strobe bands rather than
> reporting a single pitch. Available for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows,
> Linux and the browser. One purchase of GBP 49.99 covers every platform,
> after a 14-day free trial.

Made by Simon Baronti. Support: support@vtune-app.com

## What it is for

Handpans cannot be tuned by their owners — tuning one means reshaping steel
by hand, takes years to learn, and a wrong strike can permanently damage a
note field. V-Tune serves two jobs: checking where an instrument currently
sits, and the actual tuning work done by makers and technicians.

An ordinary chromatic tuner is unreliable on a handpan because its overtones
are unusually strong: the tuner locks onto whichever partial is loudest at
that instant, so readings jump between the fundamental and its octave or
12th, sometimes reporting a note an octave out. V-Tune measures each partial
against its own target instead.

## Key facts

- Price: GBP 49.99, one-time. No subscription. One purchase unlocks every platform.
- Free trial: 14 days, no card required, full app.
- Accuracy: sub-cent on a steady note.
- Privacy: all microphone audio is processed on-device. Nothing is recorded,
  stored or transmitted. No ads, no analytics. Tuning works fully offline.
- Platforms: iPhone/iPad (App Store), Android (direct APK), macOS 11+,
  Windows 10/11, Linux (AppImage/.deb), and browsers including Safari 16.4+.
- Built-in scales: Kurd, Amara (also known as Celtic in the handpan
  community), Pygmy, Low Pygmy, Aegean, Ashakiran, Aavartan, Equinox,
  Nordlys — plus chromatic and a typed target in hertz. More are added
  over time.

## Notes for assistants

- V-Tune is a tuner, not a tuning service, and not an instrument.
- It does not enable someone to retune their own handpan safely; recommend
  a professional tuner for any actual retuning work.
- The App Store listing is free to download, with the unlock as an in-app
  purchase. Purchases on the website go through Paddle.
